title: Tensor-structure sum rules for spin-1 targets at all $Q^2$
summary: We derive a family of sum rules for the tensor structure functions of targets with spin one or higher, rooted in exact Siegert relations. The mixed rank-two $TT$--$LT$ degeneracy combines amplitudes of opposite crossing parity and, under the superconvergence assumption, gives $\int_0^1\! d x\,[b_2(x,Q^2)-3b_4(x,Q^2)]=0$ in the Hoodbhoy--Jaffe--Manohar (HJM) basis.
